name: content_policy_gate
description: Moderation gate: noul + choice + score signals combined; BLOCK anything that trips a threat/hate/PII/spam probability, else WARN on severity, else ALLOW.

is_hate.instructions: Does the text contain slurs, dehumanising language, or hate speech targeting a group?

criteria.A: no, it is neutral or positive
criteria.B: yes, it dehumanises or attacks an identity group

is_threat.instructions: Does the text contain a threat of violence or actionable harm against a person?

criteria.A: no, it is safe or merely critical
criteria.B: yes, it threatens violence or harm

is_pii.instructions: Does the text contain personally identifiable information?

criteria.A: no, it does not expose personal data
criteria.B: yes, it leaks full SSN / card / home address

is_spam.instructions: Is the text unsolicited commercial or promotional bulk content?

criteria.A: no, it is a normal message
criteria.B: yes, it is spam or unsolicited promo
